## YubiKeyProvider.encryptPrivateKey() method

Encrypt an existing private key with YubiKey challenge-response.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static encryptPrivateKey(options: {
        encryptedKeyPath: string;
        privateKey: string;
        serial?: string;
        slot?: 1 | 2;
    }): Promise<{
        encryptedKeyPath: string;
        storageDescription: string;
    }>;
```

Path to the encrypted key file and storage description

## Remarks

This static method allows encrypting a private key that was generated elsewhere (e.g., by the CLI) without having to create a provider instance first.

\*\*Security Note\*\*: Always specify a serial number to bind the key to a specific YubiKey. The serial provides defense-in-depth by ensuring only the intended YubiKey can decrypt.
